title: ACI 318-19 approximate moments for a four-span girder

rubric.text: The response should check all five conditions of 6.5.1 (including L <= 3D with unfactored loads), use the clear span ln = 8.5 m, and use wu ln^2/16 (built integrally with a column), /14 (end span, discontinuous end integral with support) and /10 (more than two spans).

expert_notes: L/D = 7.2/24.585 = 0.29 <= 3; spans equal; prismatic; uniform; four spans. wu ln^2 = 41.02 x 8.5^2 = 2,963.8. Exterior support /16 = 185.2; end span /14 = 211.7; first interior /10 = 296.4. Centre-to-centre span 9 m gives 207.7, 237.3 and 332.3 (outside the tolerance); /11 for the end span (unrestrained end) gives 269.4; /9 (two-span value) gives 329.3. A subframe analysis with patterns gives 203.2, 150.3 and 246.4 at the faces, so /16 is 9% below analysis at the exterior column here.
